summary: Planning-session projection rebuilds only the affected session rather than every planning session

replay.detail: Canonical session, candidate, preview and quarantine state is preserved without replaying unrelated sessions. A warm in-memory fixture with 30,000 planning claims measured a median 3,712.430 ms for the whole-planning rebuild versus 0.779 ms for one three-claim session; scoped SQL work stayed at 21 statements across 100, 1,000 and 10,000 sessions. This is fixture evidence, not a production latency claim.

schema.detail: No storage or schema changes; the affected subject is read through its existing claim index.

rules.detail: Planning claims retain canonical ordering and per-claim quarantine behavior. Unknown-kind and malformed-operation guards are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, claim or client format changes.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores whole-planning-history rebuilds without changing stored claims.
